COURSE PREVIEW Coming Soon Blockchain Fundamentals 1 Curriculum and course details to be confirmed Dates coming soon COURSE PREVIEW Coming Soon Course 02 Title and curriculum to be confirmed Dates coming soon COURSE PREVIEW Coming Soon Course 03 Title and curriculum to be confirmed Dates coming soon Every course follows the same structure So you always know what’s next 1 Foundation AT THE START Lecture + Assignment Build your conceptual foundation through a lecture from expert speakers, then apply it with a hands-on assignment in one subtopic. PROGRESSIVE LEARNING CYCLE Research and teaching alternate, repeating until you've covered the whole topic. 2 Research IN SPECIALIST GROUPS Processing in Specialist Groups Meet peers in small specialist subgroups. Everyone researches the same subtopic from the lecture, becomes an expert on it, and prepares a presentation. 3 Teach PEER-TO-PEER, THEN A NEW LECTURE Group Teaching + New Lecture Specialist groups teach their subtopics to each other — you present your findings and learn theirs, piecing together the full picture through peer-to-peer teaching. Then a new lecture from an expert speaker adds fresh input — kicking off the next round of the cycle. The new lecture loops you back to Step 2 - a fresh subtopic each round. Learn. Connect.
